test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: The purpose of starting the project 'Repair Cafes' was to:

options.text: invite people to learn how to avoid repairing appliances
encourage people to repair gadgets thus reducing waste
educate people about many ways of waste disposal
teach people the safe use of electronic appliances

solution:
The correct answer is **'encourage people to repair gadgets thus reducing waste**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage talks about the initiative called 'Repair Cafes' '*that allow local residents to fix household objects and electronics with the help and advice of enthusiastic volunteers.'*
 
• So, one purpose of the cafes is to repair gadgets,
 
• According to the passage, this initiative was taken in order to reduce electronic waste in Europe. The passage states - '*But significant amounts of that waste could be avoided through repairs.* '
 
• So, the other purpose is to reduce waste. 
 
• This is explained in **option 2 **making it the correct answer.
